items.title: Buddy Collette interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: Jimmy Lyons, I guess it was Jimmy Lyons, or was that —

ctx.x: I mean after he liked it, yeah, he got with it. But it was a good album. Jimmy Lyons, I guess it was Jimmy Lyons, or was that —
Yeah, he was the jazz DJ?
